name: Seraphic Shadows
source:
Of the seven Virtues that nurture the world, the deity of Kindness is the one to grace the earth most frequently. Captivated by the silken saintess she meets in a chance encounter, Kindness's heart begins to clash with her judgement. Will she be able to confront what's underneath the surface?

[From [url=https://sylvelanthia.itch.io/seraphic-shadows]itch.io[/url]]
